convert_vissl_model_to_detectron2: convert a VISSL SSL framework model to a Detectron2 compatible model using the CLI script
rename_weights_detectron2: rename VISSL model weight keys to Detectron2 naming conventions for trunk layers
convert_layer_names: convert VISSL layer names to Detectron2 format by mapping feature blocks and batch norm layers
map_vissl_to_d2_weights: map VISSL state dict weights to Detectron2 format skipping head layers like fc1 and fc2
load_vissl_state_dict: load a VISSL state dict from file and extract the model weights using a specified key name
